newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby Union - Horan poses major threat - Mehrtens.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union - Horan poses major threat - Mehrtens.

text.p: WELLINGTON, July 3 - Wallaby first five-eighth Tim Horan is a big threat to the All Blacks in Saturday's Bledisloe Cup rugby test at Lancaster Park, says injured number 10 Andrew Mehrtens.
Mehrtens yesterday withdrew from the All Blacks as he was not sure his injured hamstring would be right on Saturday.
His replacement, Aucklander Carlos Spencer, must now deal with Horan and do the goal-kicking.
"They talk about Horan never having played at first-five before, but just looking at him and his play I would assume that at some stage he must have," Mehrtens said.

"He's a hell of a player and he's got a ton of experience. It's a matter of what you've learnt from your previous games really, and I think he's the sort of guy who would have learnt a lot from centre and fullback and can probably bring some very good qualities from those positions to first-five."
Mehrtens wonders whether Horan's lack of an experienced kicking game will really count against him.
"We haven't seen him kick a lot and maybe they aren't going to. He's pretty robust and what his selection means is that the Wallabies have seven attacking backs willing to have a go."
